postInstall.message:
common-styling installed.

Wire up your layout (pos-app class, init partial) and the required instance
setting in one interactive step:

  pos-cli generate run modules/common-styling/generators/install

Prefer to wire things up by hand? See the module README, Setup section, for the manual steps:
https://github.com/Platform-OS/pos-modules/blob/master/pos-module-common-styling/README.md
